questions.context_sentence: Good communication skills are key to success in life.
questions.cn: 良好的沟通技巧是生活中成功的关键。
questions.hint: 联想 "commute(通勤)" + "cation(假期)"，上班路上大家用手机交流。
questions.prompt: Good ____ skills are key to success in life.

questions.context_sentence: We need to talk face to face to solve this problem.
questions.cn: 我们需要面对面谈谈来解决这个问题。
questions.hint: face(脸)对face(脸)，面对面交流最真诚。

questions.context_sentence: I sent a text message to tell him the news.
questions.cn: 我发了一条短信告诉他这个消息。
questions.hint: text(文字) + message(信息) = 文字短信。

questions.meaning: 手势；迹象；标志 v. 签(名)；签字
questions.context_sentence: She used sign language to talk with her deaf friend.
questions.cn: 她用手语和她失聪的朋友交谈。
questions.hint: g不发音，想象用手势(sign)签名(sign)。
questions.prompt: She used ____ language to talk with her deaf friend. (提示: 手语的)

questions.context_sentence: The speaker gave a wonderful speech on communication.
questions.cn: 发言者就沟通发表了精彩的演讲。
questions.hint: speak(说) + er(人) = 说话的人/演讲者。

questions.context_sentence: The school play rehearsal will end at 7 p.m.
questions.cn: 学校话剧排练将在晚上7点结束。
questions.hint: re(再次) + hear(听) + sal，一遍遍听和练就是排练。

questions.context_sentence: If you visit my city, I will show you around.
questions.cn: 如果你来我的城市参观，我会带你到处转转。
questions.hint: show(展示) sb(某人) around(周围)，带到处转转。
questions.prompt: If you visit my city, I will ____ you around. (提示: 带参观)

questions.meaning: 当地的；地方的 n. 当地人；本地人
questions.context_sentence: I want to try all the delicious local food.
questions.cn: 我想尝尝所有美味的当地食物。
questions.hint: location(地点)的前缀，指本地的。

questions.context_sentence: A face-to-face talk usually works the best.
questions.cn: 面对面的交谈通常效果最好。
questions.hint: 加了连字符就变成了形容词，修饰名词 talk。

questions.context_sentence: The professor gave us a helpful speech.
questions.cn: 这位教授给我们做了一场很有帮助的演讲。
questions.hint: pro(向前) + fess(说) + or(人)，在讲台上侃侃而谈的是教授。
questions.prompt: The ____ gave us a helpful speech.

questions.context_sentence: Thank you for the helpful speech on communication.
questions.cn: 谢谢你关于沟通的有益演讲。
questions.hint: spea(k)变ch，上台演讲(speech)要开口(speak)。
questions.prompt: Thank you for the helpful ____ on communication.

questions.context_sentence: Sometimes my friends and I argue but don't know how to make up.
questions.cn: 有时候我和朋友们会争吵，但不知道如何言归于好。
questions.hint: 阿爸(ar)与你(gue)意见不合，开始争吵。

questions.context_sentence: We had a fight, but we soon made up.
questions.cn: 我们吵了一架，但很快就言归于好了。
questions.hint: 把(关系)重新化妆修补好，就是言归于好。

questions.context_sentence: Meeting in person is not always easy.
questions.cn: 亲自见面并不总是那么容易。
questions.hint: 带着你这个人(person)亲自去。
questions.prompt: Meeting ____ person is not always easy. (提示: 亲自)

questions.context_sentence: Some of you may prefer texting over calling.
questions.cn: 你们有些人可能比起打电话更喜欢发信息。
questions.hint: pre(预先) + fer(拿) -> 预先拿定的主意，更喜欢。

questions.meaning: 镇静的；沉着的 v. 使平静；使镇静
questions.context_sentence: If you stay calm and say sorry, it will help.
questions.cn: 如果你保持冷静并道歉，会有帮助的。
questions.hint: l不发音，深呼吸保持冷静(calm)。

questions.context_sentence: You don't need to worry about what other people say.
questions.cn: 你不需要担心别人说什么。
questions.hint: worry(担心) + about(关于)，对……操心。
questions.prompt: You don't need to ____ about what other people say. (提示: 担心)

questions.context_sentence: The expressions in the box may help you.
questions.cn: 方框里的表达方式可能会帮到你。
questions.hint: express(表达)名词化，把想法按压(press)出来。

questions.meaning: 机会；可能性 adj. 意外的；偶然的
questions.context_sentence: If you want to make some new friends, this is a good chance.
questions.cn: 如果你想结交一些新朋友，这是一个好机会。
questions.hint: 去法国(France)旅游是个好机会(chance)。

questions.context_sentence: If we have a face-to-face meeting, we'll understand each other better.
questions.cn: 如果我们进行面对面的会面，我们会更好地理解彼此。
questions.hint: meet(遇见) + ing(名词后缀) = 聚会/会议。
questions.prompt: If we have a face-to-face ____, we'll understand each other better.

questions.context_sentence: If the old man has difficulties in hearing, you can write things down.
questions.cn: 如果这位老人听力有困难，你可以把事情写下来。
questions.hint: diffic(ult)困难 + ty = 困难。
questions.prompt: If the old man has ____ in hearing, you can write things down.

questions.context_sentence: I'll call you right away.
questions.cn: 我马上给你打电话。
questions.hint: 立刻走开(away)或行动，就是马上。

questions.context_sentence: Drop me a line and let me know if you can come.
questions.cn: 给我写个便条，让我知道你能来吗。
questions.hint: 写一行字(line)就是便条。

questions.context_sentence: If you can come, drop me a line.
questions.cn: 如果你能来，给我写封信。
questions.hint: 给某人扔下一行字，即写信或留言。
questions.prompt: If you can come, drop me a ____. (提示: 行/便条)

questions.context_sentence: I will give you all the details about the reunion.
questions.cn: 我会给你提供关于这次聚会的所有细节。
questions.hint: de(向下) + tail(尾巴)，抓住每一个微小的尾巴看细节。

questions.context_sentence: Just think how great our school reunion will be!
questions.cn: 想想我们的学校聚会有多棒！
questions.hint: re(重新) + union(联合)，再次联合在一起是团聚。

questions.context_sentence: Promise me you'll think about it seriously.
questions.cn: 答应我你会认真考虑这件事。
questions.hint: serious(严肃的) + ly(副词后缀)。
questions.prompt: Promise me you'll think about it ____.

questions.context_sentence: We need to make a plan for our team training.
questions.cn: 我们需要为我们的团队训练制定一个计划。
questions.hint: train(火车/培养) + ing = 训练。

questions.context_sentence: Do you get nervous when you talk to someone?
questions.cn: 你和别人说话时会感到紧张吗？
questions.hint: nerve(神经) + ous(多……的) = 神经紧绷的，紧张的。

questions.context_sentence: Do you find it hard to have a conversation with a stranger?
questions.cn: 你觉得和陌生人交谈难吗？
questions.hint: strange(奇怪的/陌生的) + er = 陌生人。
questions.prompt: Do you find it hard to have a conversation with a ____?

questions.meaning: n. 指点；实用的提示；尖端 v. 倾斜
questions.context_sentence: Here are some tips for making better conversations.
questions.cn: 这里有一些进行更好对话的实用小贴士。
questions.hint: 笔尖(tip)给你的实用小贴士(tip)。
questions.prompt: Here are some ____ for making better conversations.

questions.meaning: adv. 认真地；仔细地；小心地
questions.context_sentence: Listen carefully and show interest in others.
questions.cn: 认真聆听并对他人表现出兴趣。
questions.hint: careful(认真的) + ly = 认真地。

questions.context_sentence: Show interest in others when they speak.
questions.cn: 当别人说话时，对他们表现出兴趣。
questions.hint: show(展示) + interest(兴趣) + in(在……方面)。

questions.context_sentence: If you are a good listener, you will find good points to ask about.
questions.cn: 如果你是一个好的倾听者，你会发现好的问题去询问。
questions.hint: listen(听) + er(人) = 听众。
questions.prompt: If you are a good ____, you will find good points to ask about.

questions.meaning: n. 观点；重点 v. 指向；瞄准
questions.context_sentence: You will find some good points to ask questions about.
questions.cn: 你会发现一些好的观点用来提问。
questions.hint: 手指一点(point)，指出核心观点(point)。

questions.context_sentence: They will surely be happy to continue the conversation.
questions.cn: 他们必定会高兴地继续谈话。
questions.hint: sure(确定的) + ly(副词) = 必定。

questions.context_sentence: They will surely be happy to continue the conversation.
questions.cn: 他们必定会高兴地继续谈话。
questions.hint: con + tinue(连续)，不断继续。
questions.prompt: They will surely be happy to ____ the conversation.

questions.context_sentence: It is impolite to ask someone's age or weight.
questions.cn: 询问某人的年龄或体重是不礼貌的。
questions.hint: im(否定前缀) + polite(礼貌的) = 不礼貌的。

questions.context_sentence: Don't ask about other people's personal information.
questions.cn: 不要打听别人的个人信息。
questions.hint: person(人) + al(形容词后缀) = 个人的。

questions.context_sentence: If you don't agree with others, don't argue with them.
questions.cn: 如果你不同意别人的观点，不要和他们争论。
questions.hint: argue(争吵) + with(和……) = 与某人争吵。
questions.prompt: If you don't agree with others, don't ____ with them. (提示: 争吵)

questions.meaning: phrase 换话题；开始做(别的事)
questions.context_sentence: Just move on to another topic.
questions.cn: 换个话题吧。
questions.hint: move(移动) + on(向前)，向前走、换话题。
questions.prompt: Just ____ on to another topic. (提示: 移动/转移)

questions.context_sentence: Be honest and sincere when talking to others.
questions.cn: 与他人交谈时要诚实真诚。
questions.hint: 心(sin)很稀罕(cere)真诚的人。

questions.context_sentence: People can find out you are not telling the truth.
questions.cn: 人们会发现你没有说实话。
questions.hint: 找(find)到外面(out)去，真相大白。

questions.meaning: v. 付费；交纳 n. 工资；薪水
questions.context_sentence: Pay attention to your body language.
questions.cn: 注意你的肢体语言。
questions.hint: 买单要 pay 钱。

questions.context_sentence: Pay attention to your body language.
questions.cn: 注意你的肢体语言。
questions.hint: at + tend(倾向于) + ion = 集中注意力。

questions.context_sentence: Pay attention to your teacher in class.
questions.cn: 上课时注意听老师讲课。
questions.hint: 付出(pay)注意力(attention)。

questions.context_sentence: Stand up straight, smile, and be yourself.
questions.cn: 站直，微笑，做你自己。
questions.hint: 做(be)你自己(yourself)，展现本色。
questions.prompt: Stand up straight, smile, and ____ yourself. (提示: 是)

questions.meaning: v. 提供；主动提出 n. 主动提议
questions.context_sentence: You have a lot to offer.
questions.cn: 你有很多东西可以奉献/提供。
questions.hint: of + fer(拿) -> 拿给别人，主动提供。

questions.context_sentence: Do you think the tips are reasonable?
questions.cn: 你认为这些建议合理吗？
questions.hint: reason(理由) + able(能……的) = 有道理的，合理的。

questions.meaning: adj. 社会的；社交的 n. 联谊会
questions.context_sentence: Social media is becoming a big part of teenagers' lives.
questions.cn: 社交媒体正成为青少年生活的重要组成部分。
questions.hint: society(社会)的形容词形式。
questions.prompt: ____ media is becoming a big part of teenagers' lives.

questions.meaning: n. 媒介；手段 adj. 中等的
questions.context_sentence: English is an important medium of communication.
questions.cn: 英语是交流的重要媒介。
questions.hint: 介于(mid)中间的媒介。
questions.prompt: English is an important ____ of communication.

questions.context_sentence: Many people communicate by social media.
questions.cn: 许多人通过社交媒体进行交流。
questions.hint: social(社交的) + media(媒体)。

questions.context_sentence: It is easier to build trust and develop stronger relationships.
questions.cn: 建立信任和发展更牢固的关系更容易。
questions.hint: 特拉斯(trust)值得信任。

questions.context_sentence: This can keep us away from misunderstandings.
questions.cn: 这可以让我们远离误解。
questions.hint: 保持(keep)在远处(away from)。
questions.prompt: This can keep us ____ from misunderstandings. (提示: 远离的)

questions.context_sentence: Good communication can keep us away from misunderstandings.
questions.cn: 良好的沟通可以让我们远离误解。
questions.hint: mis(错误) + understanding(理解) = 误解。

questions.meaning: n. 公开活动；重要事情
questions.context_sentence: We would like to invite you to give a speech at our Education Talk event.
questions.cn: 我们想邀请你在我们的教育演讲活动上发表演讲。
questions.hint: e(出) + vent(风/出口)，重大的事件轰动出门。

questions.meaning: adj. 开篇的；开始的 n. 开始
questions.context_sentence: Decide whether each sentence is the opening or the closing.
questions.cn: 判断每个句子是开头还是结尾。
questions.hint: open(打开) + ing = 开幕的/开头的。
questions.prompt: Decide whether each sentence is the ____ or the closing. (提示: 开幕的; 开始的)

questions.meaning: adj. 结尾的；结束的 n. 关闭
questions.context_sentence: This is the closing sentence of the letter.
questions.cn: 这是信件的结束句。
questions.hint: close(关闭) + ing = 结尾的。

questions.meaning: n. 句子；判决 v. 判决
questions.context_sentence: Underline the date, time, place, and topic of the speech.
questions.cn: 在演讲的日期、时间、地点和主题下画线。
questions.hint: send(发送) + tence -> 把词语送在一起组成句子。
questions.prompt: Underline the date, time, place, and topic of the ____. (提示: 演讲)

questions.meaning: n. 日期；日子；约会 v. 确定年代
questions.context_sentence: Underline the date, time, place, and topic.
questions.cn: 在日期、时间、地点和主题下画线。
questions.hint: 带着(da)他(te)去约会、定日期。

questions.context_sentence: Can you use if-clauses to talk about possible future actions?
questions.cn: 你能用if从句来谈论未来可能发生的行为吗？
questions.hint: 拼写像 cause(原因)，语法里是从句(clause)。
questions.prompt: Can you use if-____ to talk about possible future actions?

questions.context_sentence: Yours sincerely, Tom.
questions.cn: 谨上，汤姆。
questions.hint: sincere(真诚的) + ly(副词后缀)。

questions.context_sentence: The event will take place at 9 a.m. on 10th January.
questions.cn: 活动将于1月10日上午9点举行。
questions.hint: 占据(take)地方(place)，即活动发生、举行。

questions.meaning: n. 费用；价钱；代价 v. 价格为
questions.context_sentence: We will cover all your travel and hotel costs.
questions.cn: 我们将承担你所有的旅行和酒店费用。
questions.hint: 考死(cost)人的高昂费用。
questions.prompt: We will cover all your travel and hotel ____.

questions.context_sentence: The event is an excellent opportunity for students.
questions.cn: 这次活动对学生来说是一个极好的机会。
questions.hint: op(朝着) + port(港口) -> 船进港的好机会。

questions.context_sentence: We are sure the students will benefit a lot from you.
questions.cn: 我们确信学生们会从你这里受益匪浅。
questions.hint: bene(好) + fit(适合) = 好处、受益。

questions.context_sentence: Students will benefit a lot from the speech.
questions.cn: 学生们将从演讲中获益良多。

questions.prompt: Students will ____ a lot from the speech.

questions.context_sentence: We are looking forward to your reply.
questions.cn: 我们期待您的回复。
questions.hint: re(再次) + ply(折叠/回应)，再次回信。

questions.hint: meet(遇见) + ing(名词后缀) = 聚会/会议。

questions.context_sentence: If the old man has difficulties in hearing, you can write things down.
questions.cn: 如果这位老人听力有困难，你可以把事情写下来。
questions.hint: diffic(ult)困难 + ty = 困难。
questions.prompt: (提示: 困难；难题) If the old man has ____ in hearing, you can write things down.

questions.context_sentence: I'll call you right away.
questions.cn: 我马上给你打电话。
questions.hint: 立刻走开(away)或行动，就是马上。
questions.prompt: (提示: 立即；马上) I'll call you ____.

questions.context_sentence: Drop me a line and let me know if you can come.
questions.cn: 给我写个便条，让我知道你能来吗。
questions.hint: 写一行字(line)就是便条。

questions.context_sentence: If you can come, drop me a line.
questions.cn: 如果你能来，给我写封信。
questions.hint: 给某人扔下一行字，即写信或留言。

questions.context_sentence: I will give you all the details about the reunion.
questions.cn: 我会给你提供关于这次聚会的所有细节。
questions.hint: de(向下) + tail(尾巴)，抓住每一个微小的尾巴看细节。
questions.prompt: (提示: 细节；详情) I will give you all the ____ about the reunion.

questions.context_sentence: Just think how great our school reunion will be!
questions.cn: 想想我们的学校聚会有多棒！
questions.hint: re(重新) + union(联合)，再次联合在一起是团聚。

questions.context_sentence: Promise me you'll think about it seriously.
questions.cn: 答应我你会认真考虑这件事。
questions.hint: serious(严肃的) + ly(副词后缀)。

questions.context_sentence: We need to make a plan for our team training.
questions.cn: 我们需要为我们的团队训练制定一个计划。
questions.hint: train(火车/培养) + ing = 训练。
questions.prompt: (提示: 训练；培训) We need to make a plan for our team ____.

questions.meaning: adj. 担忧的；焦虑的；胆怯的
questions.context_sentence: Do you get nervous when you talk to someone?
questions.cn: 你和别人说话时会感到紧张吗？
questions.hint: nerve(神经) + ous(多……的) = 神经紧绷的，紧张的。

questions.context_sentence: Do you find it hard to have a conversation with a stranger?
questions.cn: 你觉得和陌生人交谈难吗？
questions.hint: strange(奇怪的/陌生的) + er = 陌生人。

questions.meaning: n. 指点；实用的提示；尖端 v. 倾斜
questions.context_sentence: Here are some tips for making better conversations.
questions.cn: 这里有一些进行更好对话的实用小贴士。
questions.hint: 笔尖(tip)给你的实用小贴士(tip)。
questions.prompt: (提示: 指点；实用的提示；尖端 v. 倾斜) Here are some ____ for making better conversations.

questions.meaning: adv. 认真地；仔细地；小心地
questions.context_sentence: Listen carefully and show interest in others.
questions.cn: 认真聆听并对他人表现出兴趣。
questions.hint: careful(认真的) + ly = 认真地。
questions.prompt: (提示: 认真地；仔细地；小心地) Listen ____ and show interest in others.

questions.context_sentence: Show interest in others when they speak.
questions.cn: 当别人说话时，对他们表现出兴趣。
questions.hint: show(展示) + interest(兴趣) + in(在……方面)。

questions.context_sentence: If you are a good listener, you will find good points to ask about.
questions.cn: 如果你是一个好的倾听者，你会发现好的问题去询问。
questions.hint: listen(听) + er(人) = 听众。

questions.meaning: n. 观点；重点 v. 指向；瞄准
questions.context_sentence: You will find some good points to ask questions about.
questions.cn: 你会发现一些好的观点用来提问。
questions.hint: 手指一点(point)，指出核心观点(point)。
questions.prompt: (提示: 观点；重点 v. 指向；瞄准) You will find some good ____ to ask questions about.

questions.context_sentence: They will surely be happy to continue the conversation.
questions.cn: 他们必定会高兴地继续谈话。
questions.hint: sure(确定的) + ly(副词) = 必定。

questions.context_sentence: They will surely be happy to continue the conversation.
questions.cn: 他们必定会高兴地继续谈话。
questions.hint: con + tinue(连续)，不断继续。

questions.context_sentence: It is impolite to ask someone's age or weight.
questions.cn: 询问某人的年龄或体重是不礼貌的。
questions.hint: im(否定前缀) + polite(礼貌的) = 不礼貌的。
questions.prompt: (提示: 不礼貌的；粗鲁的) It is ____ to ask someone's age or weight.

questions.context_sentence: Don't ask about other people's personal information.
questions.cn: 不要打听别人的个人信息。
questions.hint: person(人) + al(形容词后缀) = 个人的。

questions.context_sentence: If you don't agree with others, don't argue with them.
questions.cn: 如果你不同意别人的观点，不要和他们争论。
questions.hint: argue(争吵) + with(和……) = 与某人争吵。

questions.meaning: phrase 换话题；开始做(别的事)
questions.context_sentence: Just move on to another topic.
questions.cn: 换个话题吧。
questions.hint: move(移动) + on(向前)，向前走、换话题。
questions.prompt: (提示: 换话题；开始做(别的事)) Just ____ on to another topic.
